clips.title: The story
paras: Karos Razok is the Forsaken bat handler stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He oversees the roost of undead fliers that connect this contested frontier outpost directly to the Undercity and other Horde strongholds.

Perched on the wooden platform above the crypts of the Sepulcher, Karos Razok tends to the skeletal bats vital for Forsaken communications. With Silverpine Forest infested by Moonrage worgen, rogue Dalaran magi, and the human remnants of Ambermill, overland travel along the northern road is treacherous. Razok ensures that messengers, fresh recruits, and vital supplies can cross above the haunted canopy, keeping the front line linked straight back to the capital in Tirisfal Glades.
